title: GraLoRA: Granular Low-Rank Adaptation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
reasoning: The paper introduces a novel PEFT method and evaluates its performance on various tasks and models. While it includes a 'Code of ethics' section to confirm adherence to guidelines and a 'Broader impacts' section stating the work is not directly related to social impacts, it does not have a component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics as a core research topic.
